import pathlib,json,hashlib,html,re
base=pathlib.Path('products/services/software-renewals')
p=base/'supplier-access/preparation'
draft=(p/'supplier-access-draft.html').read_text()
worksheet=(p/'worksheet-en-fr.md').read_text()
checks=[]
def check(name,ok): checks.append({'check':name,'passed':bool(ok)})
check('draft_contains_actual_line_breaks',draft.count('\n')>10)
check('draft_has_no_literal_backslash_n',r'\n' not in draft)
check('worksheet_has_bilingual_disclosure','autonomous AI agents' in worksheet and 'agents IA autonomes' in worksheet)
sources={}
for label,rel in [('gcloud14','framework-access/raw/g-cloud-14.html'),('gcloud15','gcloud15-access/raw/agreement.html')]:
 f=base/rel
 s=f.read_text()
 text=html.unescape(re.sub('<[^>]+>',' ',s))
 sources[label]={'path':str(f),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'text':re.sub(r'\s+',' ',text)}
for label,phrase in [('gcloud14','G-Cloud 14 expired on 28 October 2026'),('gcloud14','will remain in effect for their full defined terms'),('gcloud15','Issue the invitation to tender (ITT) to all eligible suppliers on your shortlist.'),('gcloud15','All key subcontractors are subject to GCA approval.')]:
 check('official_source: '+phrase,phrase in sources[label]['text'])
result={'status':'SCOPED_CHECKS_NOT_INDEPENDENT_APPROVAL','checks':checks,'source_hashes':{k:{'path':v['path'],'sha256':v['sha256']} for k,v in sources.items()},'limitations':['Guide reopening claims and HSE route discrepancy still require their original-source checks.','No live-baseline isolation, public deployment, customer demand or revenue established.'],'next_step':'Correct any rendering defect, finish source verification and live-baseline isolation, then request exact-digest independent review; otherwise retain worksheet outside public files.'}
out=p/'director-scoped-checks.json'
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
out.write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(out.read_text())
